cs.Raison du départ vers Doksy (recoupement: Důvod odchodu do Doks (porovnání pramenů, 7. 10. 2026): hrabě Kristián Valdštejn-Vartenberk, pán na Šťáhlavech od roku 1816, zdědil 13. srpna 1832 po smrti svého otce Arnošta severočeská panství, mezi nimi Doksy (Hirschberg) (Sommer, Bunzlauer Kreis, 1834, s. 169). Rodina opustila Šťáhlavy po dubnu 1832 a v roce 1834 už byla ve Starých Splavech: Václav velmi pravděpodobně následoval svého pána na jeho nová panství (doklad o přeložení zatím nenalezen). Týž hrabě koupil roku 1847 panství Borossebes v Uhrách, kde byly v letech 1847–1857 v Menyháze usazeny české rodiny: tak se tam zřejmě dostal i Vencel.

en.ARGUMENT FORT : en 1855, la même branche: STRONG ARGUMENT: in 1855, the same branch of the Counts Waldstein (Münchengrätz line) owned Šťáhlavy (birthplace of Václav), Mnichovo Hradiště (Rečkov / Malá Bělá, where his cousin František lived) and, in Hungary, Borossebes and Monyásza (Menyháza, birthplace of György). en.CONTEXTE : Nebílovy, Šťáhlavy et Choceni: CONTEXT: Nebílovy, Šťáhlavy and Chocenice belonged to Jan Vojtěch Černín z Chudenic, Supreme Master of the Hunt of the Kingdom of Bohemia (nejvyšší lovčí), builder of Kozel hunting lodge (1784-1789). This explains Petr's move from Netunice to Šťáhlavy (same lord). Source: https://dspace.zcu.cz/items/92cbf6e7-be82-47d2-b6ce-aadefacf8ef8 . Parish of Blovice (Chocenice estate) checked without result: index 1734–1771 (births, marriages, deaths, "Blovice 04" and "05") and marriage and death index 1772–1784 ("Blovice 07").

en.Déplacements expliqués (recoupement, 7 o: Moves explained (cross-check, 7 Oct 2026): Šťáhlavy, Nebílovský Borek and Kamínky all belonged to one and the same estate, Šťáhlavy-Nebílovy (united in 1715, owned by the Czernins, then by the Waldsteins from 1816), which had 8 forest districts, including that of Kamínky (Sommer, Pilsner Kreis, 1838, p. 77). Petr therefore never changed employer: he was transferred from one keeper's post to another on the lands of the same lord.

en.HYPOTHÈSE (non prouvée) : garde-chasse d: HYPOTHESIS (unproven): gamekeeper on the neighbouring Nebílovy estate (castle 2-3 km away). Netunice and Nebílovy had the same lords (Steinau from 1705, then Countess Antonie, hence the Černíns); Nebílovy later passed to the Waldsteins, like Šťáhlavy (date to be checked). The 1784 record does not name his employer. To prove: Nebílovy manorial archives (SOA Plzeň, not digitised) or baptisms of his children. en.HYPOTHÈSE : sœur de György (même nom trè: HYPOTHESIS: sister of György (same very rare name, born c. 1862 25 km from Menyháza, settled in Budapest). Probably "the sister who left with the money" in the family account (she and her husband allegedly bought a large hardware store in Budapest); not confirmed: in 1897-1899 her husband is only a commission agent, then a sales agent (ügynök).

His wife is called “Katharina Walterin, of Šťáhlavy” (1790), then “Kateřina Waltrová”: this is indeed Kateřina Wolf of Šťáhlavy (the priest garbled the name).
en.IDENTITÉ À TRANCHER : le seul fils Václa: IDENTITY TO BE SETTLED: the couple’s only known son named Václav is Vencel, born 8 January 1831 at Šťáhlavy, whom the tree identifies (as a hypothesis) with Vencel of Menyháza in Hungary. Either this Wenzel of Fichtenbach IS the Václav of 1831 (and Vencel of Hungary is someone else), or he is a son born after 1843 at Thammühl (Doksy) not yet found. His age (marriage or death record) will settle it. His rank of assistant forester in 1868 rather suggests a young man (born about 1840-1846).

en.Lieu de naissance donné au baptême de sa: Place of birth given at the baptism of his daughter Gizella (1893): "Menyháza, Arad m.". Year based on his age at death (74 in 1937). en.Mort à 6 mois, d'hydrocéphalie, à Podol: Died aged 6 months, of hydrocephalus, at Podol no. 5; buried on 13 December at Bělá. The note in the margin of the baptism (same child, same date of death, buried at Bělá) proves he was the son of František and Barbora Mrázová, who had settled in Podol by late 1865.

en.REMISE EN CAUSE (8 oct. 2026, Ancestry): CALLED INTO QUESTION (8 Oct 2026, Ancestry): at his marriage on 10 July 1855 at Buteni, Vencel was 33 (born about 1822) and came from “Blany(?) in Bohemia”. This does not fit the Václav born on 8 January 1831 at Šťáhlavy (24 in 1855), especially since another Wenzel, son of Václav and Antonia Bauda, lived at Fichtenbach from 1868 to 1907. en.Raison du départ vers Doksy (recoupement: Reason for the move to Doksy (cross-check, 7 Oct 2026): Count Christian Waldstein-Wartenberg, lord of Šťáhlavy since 1816, inherited the northern estates, including Hirschberg (Doksy), on 13 August 1832 at the death of his father Ernst (Sommer, Bunzlauer Kreis, 1834, p. 169). The family left Šťáhlavy after April 1832 and was at Thammühl by 1834: Václav very probably followed his lord to his new lands (no transfer document found so far). Sommer (p. 172) describes the “Thamer Revier” (1,868 joch, about 1,075 ha of beech, pine and spruce) and a game park created in 1825-1826 that included it: a post for an experienced gamekeeper. The same count bought the Borossebes estate in Hungary in 1847, where Bohemian families were settled at Menyháza between 1847 and 1857: this is probably how Vencel got there.

hu.Récit consigné par l'IRO : né en 1902 à: Az IRO által rögzített elbeszélés: 1902-ben született Polában, zsidó osztrák–magyar szülőktől (magyar apa, trieszti családból származó anya); 1913-ban megkeresztelkedett, protestáns; katonai iskolák, majd kémiai tanulmányok a budapesti egyetemen 1921-ig, amikor anyjával Milánóba utazott, és egy vegyészi állás miatt ott maradt. 1939–1944: főportás a milánói Diana Majestic szállóban; 1944 novemberében az SS kereste, Svájcba menekült (Bellinzona, Palerna[?], Lugano, Saint-Cergue táborai); 1945. ápr. 28-án vissza Milánóba, ismét a Diana szállóba, majd az Eden (1946. okt. – 1948. máj.) és a Marino Scala szállóba (1950 áprilisáig). 1950 áprilisától a sestri levantei Grand Hotel Villa Balbiban dolgozik. 1938-as magyar útlevelét már nem ismerik el; Magyarországra nem akar visszatérni, de szeretné meglátogatni Budapesten élő anyját.
